description: Configurable parameters of the AWS EBS CSI Driver

additionalDaemonSets.description: Additional DaemonSets of the node pod

additionalArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to the controller pod

batching.description: Enable batching of API calls. Improves performance in workloads that are sensitive to EC2 rate limits.

defaultFsType.description: The default filesystem type of the volume to provision when fstype is unspecified in the StorageClass. If the default is not set and fstype is unset in the StorageClass, then no fstype will be set

dnsConfig.description: DNS configuration for the controller pod

enableMetrics.description: Enable metrics collection for the controller pod

enableNodeLocalVolumes.description: Enable support for node-local volumes that use pre-attached EBS volumes

enablePrometheusAnnotations.description: If metrics are enabled, add prometheus.io/scrape and prometheus.io/port annotations to the metrics services

envFrom.description: Use envFrom to reference ConfigMaps and Secrets across all containers in the deployment

extraVolumeTags.description: Additional tags to be added to all EBS volumes

logLevel.description: Set the level of verbosity of the logs

loggingFormat.description: Log format for the driver container on the controller pod

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the controller pod

otelTracing.description: Enable opentelemetry tracing for the plugin running on the daemonset

podAnnotations.description: Annotations applied to the controller pod

enabled.description: Enables/Disables the EBS CSI Controller Pod's PodDisruptionBudget which ensures that at least 1 controller Pod is always able to Attach/Detach/Create/Delete volumes. Warning: Disabling PodDisruptionBudget may lead to delays in stateful workloads starting due to controller pod restarts or evictions.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number or percentage of unavailable pods for the PodDisruptionBudget. If non-null, no default value is used for both maxUnavailable and minAvailable.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number or percentage of available pods for the PodDisruptionBudget. If non-null, no default value is used for both maxUnavailable and minAvailable.

unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy.description: Unhealthy pod eviction policy for the EBS CSI Controller Pod's PodDisruptionBudget

priorityClassName.description: Priority class for the controller Deployment

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas in the controller Deployment

resources.description: Resource requests/limits of the controller pod

sdkDebugLog.description: Enables debug logging of the AWS SDK via --aws-sdk-debug-log=true

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Enable if EKS IAM for SA is used

serviceMonitor.description: Parameters to configure the ServiceMonitor for the EBS CSI controller pods

forceEnable.description: Render ServiceMonitor object even when CRD is not detected

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for the controller pod

enabled.description: Enable modification of volume type, iops, etc via volume-modifier-for-k8s sidecar

volumeMounts.description: Add additional volume mounts on the controller

volumes.description: Add additional volumes to be mounted onto the controller

customLabels.description: Custom labels added to Kubernetes objects

debugLogs.description: Set maximum verbosity for logs of each container and other recommended debugging parameters such as enabling AWS SDK debug logging

fips.description: Enable FIPS 140-3 mode: instructs the AWS SDK to use FIPS endpoints via AWS_USE_FIPS_ENDPOINT and activates the Golang native FIPS 140-3 module (https://go.dev/doc/security/fips140).

additionalArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to the node pod

dnsConfig.description: DNS configuration for the node pods

enableMetrics.description: Enable metrics collection for the node pods

enablePrometheusAnnotations.description: If metrics are enabled, add prometheus.io/scrape and prometheus.io/port annotations to the metrics services

hostNetwork.description: Run node pods on the host network

legacyXFS.description: Warning: This option will be removed in a future release. It is a temporary workaround for users unable to immediately migrate off of older kernel versions. Formats XFS volumes with bigtime=0,inobtcount=0,reflink=0, for mounting onto nodes with linux kernel version <= 5.4. Note that XFS volumes formatted with this option will only have timestamp records until 2038

logLevel.description: Set the level of verbosity of the node logs

loggingFormat.description: Log format for the driver container on the node pod

metadataSources.description: Comma separated list of metadata sources that override the default used by the EBS CSI Driver. Valid sources include 'imds', 'kubernetes', and (ALPHA) 'metadata-labeler'

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the node pod

otelTracing.description: Enable opentelemetry tracing for the plugin running on the daemonset

podAnnotations.description: Annotations applied to the node pod

priorityClassName.description: Priority class for the Node Daemonset

reservedVolumeAttachments.description:
The number of attachment slots to reserve for system use (and not to be used for CSI volumes)
When this parameter is not specified (or set to -1), the EBS CSI Driver will attempt to determine the number of reserved slots via heuristic

resources.description: Resource requests/limits of the node pod

selinux.description: Enable SELinux-only optimizations on the EBS CSI Driver node pods. Must only be set true if all linux nodes in the DaemonSet have SELinux enabled

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Enable if EKS IAM for SA is used

disableMutation.description: Disable mutating permissions for the node service account. When enabled, some features of the EBS CSI Driver node pods will not function, such as taint removal. Primarily useful in particularly security-sensitive environments, or on multi-tenant clusters that isolate tenants by node.

serviceMonitor.description: Parameters to configure the ServiceMonitor for the EBS CSI node pods

forceEnable.description: Render ServiceMonitor object even when CRD is not detected

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Number of seconds to wait before forcefully terminating a stopping node pod

tolerateAllTaints.description: Node pods will tolerate all taints

volumeAttachLimit.description: Overrides the maximum number of volumes that can be attached per node (for all nodes)

nodeAllocatableUpdatePeriodSeconds.description: nodeAllocatableUpdatePeriodSeconds updates the node's max attachable volume count by directing Kubelet to periodically call NodeGetInfo at the configured interval. Kubernetes enforces a minimum update interval of 10 seconds. A value of -1 uses a automatically determined value dependent on metadata sources. This parameter is supported in Kubernetes 1.33+, the MutableCSINodeAllocatableCount feature gate must be enabled in kubelet and kube-apiserver.
